picks.title: Uprising
picks.highlight: 雷鬼传奇 Bob Marley 经典专辑重发，收录《Could You Be Loved》，牙买加节奏与信念之声永不褪色。
picks.highlightEn: Reggae legend Bob Marley's classic reissued with 'Could You Be Loved' — Jamaican rhythm and messages of faith still resonate.
picks.summary: 1979年录音室专辑重制再版，融合雷鬼、放克与灵性歌词，是鲍勃·马利晚期代表作。
picks.summaryEn: Remastered reissue of the 1979 studio album, blending reggae, funk and spiritual lyrics — a late-period Marley landmark.

picks.title: The Stooges
picks.highlight: 朋克前传式车库摇滚经典，Iggy 的原始咆哮与粗糙吉他，重听依然火力全开。
picks.highlightEn: Proto-punk garage-rock classic: Iggy's raw howl and scrappy guitars still hit with full force.
picks.summary: 1969年首张专辑再版，定义原型朋克与车库摇滚，粗粝能量影响后世无数乐队。
picks.summaryEn: Reissue of the 1969 debut that helped define proto-punk and garage rock, its raw energy influencing countless bands.

picks.title: CANDY TUNE SOLO BOX
picks.highlight: 日本少女偶像组合 CANDY TUNE 推出 solo 精选盒，甜美电音与元气舞台感满载。
picks.highlightEn: Japanese idol group CANDY TUNE's solo selection box overflows with sweet electro-pop and energetic stage charm.
picks.summary: 日本偶像团体成员个人曲精选，轻快电子流行与应援式合唱，展现原宿系青春能量。
picks.summaryEn: A solo-track collection from the Japanese idol group, mixing upbeat electropop and call-and-response choruses with Harajuku-style youth energy.

picks.title: The Power Station
picks.highlight: 80年代超级乐队唯一专辑重发，Chic 节奏组与 Duran Duran 吉他手碰撞出硬朗放克摇滚。
picks.highlightEn: The '80s supergroup's sole album returns, with Chic's rhythm section colliding with Duran Duran's guitarist for tough funk-rock.
picks.summary: 1985年同名专辑再版，融合放克、新浪潮与硬摇滚，Robert Palmer 嗓音极具张力。
picks.summaryEn: Reissue of the 1985 self-titled LP, fusing funk, new wave and hard rock behind Robert Palmer's commanding voice.

picks.title: RAVEPOP
picks.artist: r u s s e l b u c k
picks.highlight: 高能快乐硬核与 Dariacore 拼贴，失真采样和疯狂 BPM 打造一场耳膜蹦迪。
picks.highlightEn: High-octane happy hardcore meets Dariacore collage, with distorted samples and frantic BPMs for a full-on eardrum rave.
picks.summary: 网络亚文化电子拼贴，融合 happy hardcore、donk 与 jersey club，躁动又俏皮。
picks.summaryEn: Internet-subculture electronic collage merging happy hardcore, donk and Jersey club into something frantic yet playful.

picks.title: Snow, Vol. 9
picks.highlight: 德国制作人 Wun Two 的冬日低保真系列第九辑，温暖黑胶噪点与慵懒鼓点适合深夜循环。
picks.highlightEn: Wun Two's ninth winter lo-fi instalment pairs warm vinyl crackle with lazy drums — perfect for late-night loops.
picks.summary: Lo-fi hip hop 标志性系列，采样爵士与雪夜氛围，适合专注与放松场景。
picks.summaryEn: A signature lo-fi hip-hop series with jazzy samples and snowy-night atmosphere, ideal for focus or winding down.

picks.title: Monument
picks.highlight: 德国哥特金属老牌乐队新作，厚重吉他墙与阴郁键盘交织，黑暗史诗感拉满。
picks.highlightEn: New work from German gothic-metal veterans, weaving thick guitar walls and brooding keys into darkly epic scale.
picks.summary: Crematory 延续工业哥特金属路线，旋律死亡唱腔与电子音效营造压迫又华丽的氛围。
picks.summaryEn: Crematory continue their industrial-gothic metal path, using melodic death vocals and electronic textures for a压迫 yet ornate mood.

picks.title: The Great Adventure
picks.highlight: 瑞士舞曲天王 DJ BoBo 回归，励志旋律与四拍节奏，打造适合全家欢唱的派对国歌。
picks.highlightEn: Swiss dance king DJ BoBo returns with uplifting hooks and four-on-the-floor beats built for family-friendly party anthems.
picks.summary: Eurodance 老将新专辑，融合流行舞曲、励志歌词与俱乐部节拍，现场感十足。
picks.summaryEn: A new album from the Eurodance veteran, blending pop-dance, motivational lyrics and club beats with a live-show feel.

picks.title: Big Cock
picks.highlight: 英国 psychobilly 怪咖乐队重发经典，狂野贝斯与滑稽嘶吼，派对式摇滚乐妙趣横生。
picks.highlightEn: British psychobilly eccentrics reissue a classic: wild upright bass, comic yelps and party-ready rock'n'roll mischief.
picks.summary: 1980年代 psychobilly 场景代表作，融合摇滚比利、朋克与黑色幽默，风格独树一帜。
picks.summaryEn: A 1980s psychobilly scene staple, fusing rockabilly, punk and black humour into a truly singular style.

picks.title: Nothing Hurts Like Everything
picks.highlight: 加拿大独立音乐人 Ourson 的私密之作，梦幻吉他与呢喃人声包裹心碎时刻。
picks.highlightEn: An intimate release from Canadian indie artist Ourson, wrapping heartbreak in dreamy guitars and murmured vocals.
picks.summary: 低保真独立流行与梦幻流行交织，情绪细腻，适合深夜独处聆听。
picks.summaryEn: Lo-fi indie pop and dream pop intertwine with delicate emotion, best heard alone late at night.

picks.title: THE PROTÉGÉ
picks.highlight: 香港新生代 Gareth.T 首张专辑，R&B 与粤语流行融合，少年心事与都市节奏并行。
picks.highlightEn: Hong Kong newcomer Gareth.T's debut blends R&B and Cantopop, running youthful introspection alongside city rhythms.
picks.summary: 香港创作歌手展现多元风格，旋律说唱与柔和 R&B，歌词聚焦成长与自我认同。
picks.summaryEn: The Hong Kong singer-songwriter spans melodic rap and soft R&B, with lyrics centred on growing up and self-identity.

picks.title: Oaths Unbent
picks.highlight: 《鸣潮》游戏原声 EP，交响与电子交织，营造末世废土中的史诗战斗氛围。
picks.highlightEn: A Wuthering Waves EP where orchestral and electronic elements interlace, conjuring epic battles in a post-apocalyptic wasteland.
picks.summary: 开放世界游戏《鸣潮》配乐，管弦乐与民族元素融合，兼具战斗张力与探索空灵感。
picks.summaryEn: Soundtrack for open-world game Wuthering Waves, merging orchestra and folk elements with battle tension and airy exploration.

picks.title: Von Abseits
picks.highlight: 德国地下嘻哈组合 Doppelkopf 回归，冷峻押韵与社会观察，德式说唱的锋利切片。
picks.highlightEn: German underground hip-hop duo Doppelkopf return with cool-headed rhymes and social observation — a sharp slice of Deutschrap.
picks.summary: German hip hop 老牌组合新作，歌词关注社会边缘议题，节奏沉稳、叙事性强。
picks.summaryEn: New work from a veteran German hip-hop group, with lyrics on marginalised social issues, steady beats and strong storytelling.

picks.title: 崩坏3-于未来彼端回眸-Original Soundtrack
picks.highlight: 《崩坏3》最新原声大碟，HOYO-MiX 以交响与电子勾勒未来篇的宏大与柔情。
picks.highlightEn: The latest Honkai Impact 3rd soundtrack, with HOYO-MiX using orchestra and electronics to sketch future arcs both grand and tender.
picks.summary: 米哈游音乐团队打造，管弦乐、人声与电子融合，情绪起伏贴合剧情高潮。
picks.summaryEn: Crafted by miHoYo's music team, blending orchestra, vocals and electronics as emotional swells match story climaxes.

picks.title: Appalachia
picks.highlight: 阿巴拉契亚山民谣叙事，Emily Scott Robinson 以清澈嗓音唱出土地与女性的坚韧。
picks.highlightEn: Appalachian folk storytelling: Emily Scott Robinson sings of land and women's resilience in a clear, unadorned voice.
picks.summary: 美国民谣创作人专辑，原声吉他搭配细腻歌词，描绘阿巴拉契亚地区生活图景。
picks.summaryEn: An American folk singer-songwriter album, pairing acoustic guitar with finely observed lyrics about Appalachian life.

picks.title: RE-FLOW
picks.highlight: ZB1全新迷你专辑《RE-FLOW》，九人声线在合成器与舞曲节拍间流动，主打舞台值得循环。
picks.highlightEn: ZEROBASEONE's new EP RE-FLOW: nine voices flowing through synths and dance beats — the title track begs for repeat plays.
picks.summary: 韩国新生代男团高完成度舞曲EP，旋律抓耳、编曲层次分明，是本周K-Pop代表。
picks.summaryEn: A polished dance-pop EP from Korea's rising boy group — hooky melodies and layered production, this week's K-pop pick.

picks.title: The Lighthouse Session II
picks.highlight: 丹麦厄运金属名团Saturnus《灯塔录音室》第二辑，缓慢沉重的旋律与哀悼之美。
picks.highlightEn: Saturnus's second Lighthouse Session: slow, heavy melodies and a beauty that borders on mourning.
picks.summary: 现场录音版本保留长音铺陈与死亡厄运的悲怆感，适合喜欢氛围与沉重旋律的听众。
picks.summaryEn: A session recording preserving long-form build-ups and death-doom pathos — for fans of atmosphere and crushing melody.

picks.title: Unity
picks.highlight: 荷兰鞭挞金属乐队Pariah回归，急速riff与硬核冲击，献给老派thrash乐迷。
picks.highlightEn: Dutch thrashers Pariah return with rapid-fire riffs and hardcore impact — a gift to old-school thrash fans.
picks.summary: 荷兰地下金属场景的代表声音，节奏凌厉、结构紧凑，保留八九十年代鞭挞的原始快感。
picks.summaryEn: A voice from the Dutch underground: razor rhythms and tight structures keeping the raw 80s/90s thrash thrill alive.

picks.title: Eingenordet
picks.highlight: 德国中世纪民谣摇滚Versengold新作，手风琴、风笛与合唱，酒馆里的一场狂欢。
picks.highlightEn: Germany's Versengold deliver hurdy-gurdy folk rock full of accordion, pipes and tavern singalongs.
picks.summary: 德语民谣摇滚的场景代表，中世纪乐器与现代乐队编制结合，现场感与在地文化色彩强烈。
picks.summaryEn: Leading lights of German folk rock, merging medieval instruments with a modern band setup — strongly local and live-feeling.
